svg.aria-label: The final role and functionality mapping. Four platform-level permission boxes map one to one onto the four roles, mirroring the resource level. Full administration maps to the Owner, who does everything except request permission. Scoped administration maps to the Data Plane Manager: everything except Single Sign-On, only on assigned data planes. View and request maps to the Capability Manager. View only maps to the Entity Viewer. Role to resource lines then cascade into four resource cards, all granted per scope as Read or Write.
